title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain CUNY City College
description: When the North Academic Complex library winds down, CCNY students head to these Harlem and Hamilton Heights staples for fuel, from 24-hour diners to legendary pan-fried chicken.

cards.title: The 24-Hour Broadway Anchor
cards.subtitle: 3543 Broadway
cards.notes: Located just a few blocks from the South Campus, this 24/7 location is a reliable stop for students pulling all-nighters or returning from late lab sessions.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour fast food staple located on Broadway near 145th Street, serving the CCNY community at all hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The McDonald's at 3543-49 Broadway is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for both the restaurant and lobby.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in New York, NY at 3543-49 Broadway | McDonald's

cards.title: Midnight Caffeine at 145th
cards.subtitle: 356 W 145th St
cards.notes: A primary caffeine source for the northern end of campus, this 24-hour spot is conveniently located near the 145th Street subway station used by many commuters.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour coffee and donut shop situated near the 145th Street subway hub, serving students day and night.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dunkin' at 356 W 145th St is open 24 hours daily.
cards.source_title: Dunkin' at 356 W 145th St in New York | Coffee & Donuts Near You

cards.title: The Late-Night Sugar Fix
cards.subtitle: 17 W 125th St
cards.notes: A short trip south to 125th Street provides access to warm cookies until well past midnight, a favorite for student groups and dorm residents.
cards.short_summary: A late-night bakery specializing in warm cookies, open until 1:00 AM or later for pickup and delivery.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies on 125th Street is open for pickup until 12:35 AM and delivery until late night.
cards.source_title: Insomnia Cookies Delivery Menu | Order Online | 17 W 125th St New York | Grubhub
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:35 AM or later depending on the day.

cards.title: Harlem's Soul Food Flagship
cards.subtitle: 340 W 145th St
cards.notes: Famous for its pan-fried technique, this flagship location serves hearty soul food plates until 11 PM on weekends, perfect for a late dinner.
cards.short_summary: A legendary Harlem eatery known for pan-fried chicken and Southern sides, open late on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: The Harlem flagship location at 340 W 145th St is open until 11 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11 PM on Friday and Saturday; 10 PM other nights.

cards.title: The 5 AM Cravings Stop
cards.subtitle: 161 E 125th St
cards.notes: For those truly late nights, this 125th Street location stays open until 5 AM, offering a full menu of tacos and burritos for the night owl crowd.
cards.short_summary: A late-night fast food option on 125th Street open until 5:00 AM for late-night cravings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 161 East 125th St is open until 5:00 AM on Fridays.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in New York, NY - 161 East 125th ST
cards.access_notes: Open until 5:00 AM on select nights.

cards.title: The Neighborhood Study Spot
cards.subtitle: 3570 Broadway
cards.notes: A neighborhood staple with ample seating, Hamilton's serves coffee and pastries until 11 PM, making it a prime off-campus study alternative.
cards.short_summary: A spacious cafe and bakery on Broadway open until 11:00 PM daily, popular for late-night study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamilton's Cafe & Restaurant (Hamilton's Bakery) is open until 11:00 PM daily.
cards.source_title: Hamilton's Cafe & Restaurant (Hamilton's Bakery) - Uptown Guide
cards.access_notes: Open 9 AM - 11 PM Monday-Friday; 10 AM - 11 PM Saturday-Sunday.

cards.title: Late-Night Italian Comfort
cards.subtitle: 1600 Amsterdam Ave
cards.notes: Located right across from the CCNY campus, Fumo offers a lively atmosphere and Italian fare until 11 PM on weekends for a more formal late meal.
cards.short_summary: An Italian restaurant located directly adjacent to campus, offering pasta and pizza until 11:00 PM on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Fumo Harlem is open until 11 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Hours & Location | Fumo Restaurant in New York, NY
cards.access_notes: Open until 11 PM on Friday and Saturday; 10:30 PM Tuesday-Thursday.

cards.title: The LaSalle Street Trattoria
cards.subtitle: 125 La Salle St
cards.notes: A short walk south to Morningside Heights leads to this cozy Italian spot, serving dinner until 10:30 PM on weekends for students seeking a quiet escape.
cards.short_summary: An Italian trattoria in Morningside Heights known for its sustainable practices and late weekend dinner hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pisticci is open for dinner until 10:30 PM from Thursday to Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Dinner served until 10:30 PM Thursday-Saturday; 10:00 PM Sunday-Wednesday.

cards.title: BBQ Under the Viaduct
cards.subtitle: 700 W 125th St
cards.notes: This iconic BBQ joint near the 125th Street waterfront offers a 15% student discount and stays open until 11 PM on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A famous BBQ restaurant located under the Riverside Drive Viaduct, offering student discounts and late weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Dinosaur Bar-B-Que Harlem is open until 11 PM on Friday and Saturday and offers a 15% student discount with ID.
cards.source_title: Harlem BBQ | Restaurant & Catering NY - Dinosaur Bar-B-Que
cards.access_notes: Open until 11 PM on Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: The 125th Street Sub Stop
cards.subtitle: 578 West 125th St
cards.notes: A quick stop for students using the 125th Street transit corridor, this Subway provides familiar sandwich options late into the evening.
cards.short_summary: A sandwich shop located on the busy 125th Street corridor, serving students late into the night.
cards.evidence_claim: The Subway at 578 West 125th Street serves the Harlem community with late-night availability.
cards.source_title: Sandwiches, Salads, Wraps & More | SUBWAY at 578 West 125th Street New York NY
cards.access_notes: Check local store for exact nightly closing times; typically open late.
